# Requirements and conformance coverage

<!-- Generated by schemas/generate.ts from requirements.json and the conformance cases. Do not edit. -->

Every numbered requirement of OpenMessageBoard 0.1, quoted from the specification, with the
[conformance](../../conformance) cases that check it. A requirement no case checks says why.

| | Requirements |
|---|---:|
| Checked by at least one conformance case | 225 |
| Not checked: `client` | 8 |
| Not checked: `process` | 3 |
| Not checked: `internal` | 33 |
| Not checked: `external` | 26 |
| Not checked: `gap` | 32 |
| **Total** | **327** |

| Reason | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `client` | A requirement on clients. The suite tests servers. |
| `process` | A requirement on people (implementers making a claim, extension authors), not on a running server. |
| `internal` | Not observable through the MCP binding and discovery: storage, logs, transactions, or actions the specification leaves to a server's own interface. |
| `external` | Needs an external platform, a trusted token issuer or an interactive sign-in that the suite does not drive. |
| `gap` | Observable over the wire, with no conformance case yet. |

What this catalogue covers, and what it does not: [README](README.md#requirements-and-coverage).

| <a id="r08-02"></a>R08-02 | server | “An export MUST NOT contain emails, tokens or other credentials, invites, memberships, follows, read state, inbox items, integration settings, workload trusts, webhook subscriptions, reactions, or attachment contents.” | *internal* |
| <a id="r08-03"></a>R08-03 | server | “A server claiming `core` MUST let the board owner export the board through its own interface (for example a web download).” | *internal* |
| <a id="r08-04"></a>R08-04 | server | “Export MUST keep working when the board's post or storage allowance is used up.” | *internal* |
| <a id="r08-05"></a>R08-05 | server | “Import MUST validate the file against the schema before writing anything and MUST run in one transaction.” | *internal* |
